defaults.encoding: JSON bodies add Content-Type application/json; empty actions omit it; multipart runner creates boundary
defaults.given_semantics: Deep-merge given into state keyed by decimal IDs; null record deletes; arrays replace. Reset independently for every case. Fixture setup reconciles each post/comment image_url with media links; selected_follow_ids are internal setup only, never public response fields. New media/post/comment IDs deterministic in each reset. posts/comments use wire-shaped values plus internal setup associations, mapped by consumers onto DB columns; fixture setup does not run validation of invalid request input.
defaults.response_semantics: Exact body/headers subset; messages illustrative except STALE_CONTENT. bytes_fixture paths relative to repository; empty_body true means zero bytes. Header null override removes default.
defaults.expect_state_semantics: Deep subset after request; null record means absent. unchanged asserts no persisted mutation; read denials also preserve state. An empty table map asserts that table has zero rows.
defaults.synthetic_warning: Test-only future interface fixtures; no production seeds/imports; not actual current API behavior.
